description: Madagscar - Small Hydro GIS Atlas is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Hydropower, Renewable energy", published or maintained by Clara Ivanescu (World Bank Group). The GIS HydroAtlas of Madagascar is the final output from the small hydro resource mapping component of the activity “ Renewable Energy Resource Mapping and Geospatial Planning – Madagascar” [Project ID: P145350]. Coverage: Madagascar. It has 6 files in ZIP, GeoJSON, Other. The portal files it under Hydropower, Renewable energy, Resource assessments. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
